name: Bioschemas Sample properties
abstract: Properties of a biological sample from the Bioschemas Sample draft, in the bios: namespace: anatomical structure and system, sample type, collection method and collector, collection and processing dates, developmental stage, quantity, state, storage temperature, sex and related study fields. Each accepts one value or an array. Used by niaidDataset for NIAID's nde:Sample, which NIAID declares a subclass of the Bioschemas BioSample.

sources.title: Bioschemas types and properties (draft) for the Data Discovery Engine
